page.layout: One page of text, with woodcut illustrations between the text blocks: a sphere on a stand, a circle divided into eight sectors, and a rectangle with a diagonal. Running text above, below and between the figures. No margin notes. The digitiser's link at the foot is left out.

main_text.p: Recta, quæ transuersim ea in duo triangula di-spescit.
Axis ἄξων est linea recta per centrum sphæ-ræ acta, & extremitatibus suis utrinq; ad conue-xam eius superficiem penetrans, circa quam sphæ-ra uoluitur. Extrema puncta axem terminantia sunt πόλοι.
Lineæ rectæ parralleli εὐθεῖαι παράλληλοι, sunt lineæ æquabiliter ductæ, quæ in una planicie

page.notes: The Greek words are printed as ἄξων and πόλοι in the scan; "parralleli" reads as printed with the Greek παράλληλοι beside it. The line "Lineæ rectæ parralleli" is set in italic. The woodcut figures carry hand-drawn letters (f, c, e, g, h, i, a) which are not printed text. The catchword "in" is set at the right below the last line. Signature "B 5" at the foot is partly obscured.
